sdk.revision_policy: replace SDK_REVISION with an immutable commit

run.policy: persist marker+version; reject missing, older, newer, malformed, or unvalidated state

session_evidence.cas_digest: lowercase sha256 over exact payload bytes, prefixed sha256:
session_evidence.policy: compare revision+digest atomically; returned Committed version must equal SDK-computed successor

session_state.status: preparatory contract only; not a required_host_trait, production authority, or Runtime injection until native wiring lands
session_state.policy: current-only key+generation-scoped bounded objects and manifest; no GC API; immutable sha256 objects; full expected live document plus validated suffix; compare manifest revision+digest atomically; tombstones prevent ABA; reconcile CommitUnknown by exact authoritative load

migration_policy: current-only fail-closed; breaking durable schemas require explicit offline migration or deliberate discard before Runtime startup

storage_policy.injection: replaces local defaults; never mirror, write-through, or double-write
storage_policy.run_store_commit: call StoreCommit::validate_and_encode first and atomically CAS expected_revision while storing its prepared envelope and optional finished iteration
storage_policy.commit_unknown: fail closed and reconcile by authoritative load; never blindly redispatch

public_signatures.Residency: inspect_run_residency; request_run_wake; claim_run_activation; renew_run_activation; release_run_activation; AutonomousTurnLoop::activate_claimed
public_signatures.ChildMailbox: admit_run_child; settle_run_child; accept_run_message; transition_run_message; get_run/attach_run for list/join projection

product_wiring.scheduler_lease: ready: Host timer/worker claims durable lease and calls activate_claimed; shell scheduler is not authority
product_wiring.child_mailbox: ready for Host placement adapter: durable admission/budget/fenced callbacks/mailbox are authoritative; shell coordinator must only adapt
product_wiring.program_runtime: ready when Host implements ProgramRuntime and ArtifactStore; intent-before-execute and uncertain reconciliation are wired
product_wiring.persistent_kernel: contract only: Host must implement driver; VM snapshot is not durable truth and no built-in kernel ships
product_wiring.rhai_workflow: not product-ready: bounded native Rhai Run driver remains unavailable
product_wiring.native_compaction: not fully product-wired: ProgramContext supports durable checkpoint/skill pins, but native shell compaction is not a Run driver
